name: Ain Jalut - The Spring of Goliath

settings.format_line: serious, slow-burn cinematic historical drama scene

QUTUZ.look: Steel mail under a deep red coat, with a white turban wound with a yellow band
QUTUZ.voice: Adult male voice. Low pitch, stern tone, steady and unhurried delivery, clear articulation. He never raises it.

YOUNG QUTUZ.look: A dusty tunic (proposed: plain, knee-length, undyed), barefoot (proposed)
YOUNG QUTUZ.voice: A boy's voice, about ten years old. Small and light in pitch but steady, with a flat, defiant delivery and no tremble.

SHAJAR AL-DURR.look: A dark veil over the lower face and head, gold jewelry, and a long dark gown (proposed: charcoal)
SHAJAR AL-DURR.voice: Adult woman's voice. Quiet, controlled and even, with calm authority. Never raised.

ALI.look: White-and-gold sultan's robes that are visibly too large for him: sleeves past his hands, hem pooling on the floor
ALI.voice: A teenage boy's voice, about fifteen. Thin and slightly high, wavering, frightened.

SULTAN ALI.look: White-and-gold sultan's robes that are visibly too large for him: sleeves past his hands, hem pooling on the floor
SULTAN ALI.voice: A teenage boy's voice, about fifteen. Thin and slightly high, wavering, frightened.

SULTAN AYBAK.look: A tall man in a red-gold coat

ELDER EMIR.look: A red turban and a long dark robe with a plain sash (proposed)
ELDER EMIR.voice: Older adult male voice. Dry, weary, measured delivery, a little careful.

RIDER.look: Dust-covered riding clothes (proposed): a dark tunic, a faded scarf and riding boots
RIDER.voice: Adult male voice. Breathless and hoarse from hard riding, urgent.

DEALER.look: man in his 40s, stocky, short dark beard, dirty cream headcloth, stained ochre tunic with a rope sash
DEALER.voice: Adult male voice. Loud, coarse and bored.

BUYER.look: man in his 50s, lean, neat trimmed grey beard, deep blue fine coat with gold trim, soft cap
BUYER.voice: Adult male voice. Smooth, unhurried, appraising.
